name: nokki
tagline: A quiet music journal: today's song, your mood and a short note
description:
nokki turns the music you listen to into a diary. Pick the song of the day, tap the mood that fits it and add a short note; one record takes about thirty seconds. The days pile up in a calendar of hand-painted stamps, and you can look back through a memory timeline, a random memory jar, listening stats and an AI reflection that gently sums up your month.

It is not a social network. Every record is private by default, and you add a few friends by QR code to share only what you choose with them. Songs are picked from Apple Music on iPhone and from a catalog search on Android.

Everyone in nokki has a hand-drawn Humation avatar built with humation-swift, designed part by part during onboarding and rendered on the device from the saved part IDs rather than stored as an image. It appears in the home header, in the row of friends who recorded today, on the profile page over the watercolor header, in the friends list, and next to every post, comment and like.
